data_points.quote: Net hiring has collapsed from ~450,000 (FY22) to 135,000 (FY26).
Industry revenue was expected to cross $315 billion and direct employment to reach about 6 million in FY2026.
HCLTech's CEO said ‘AI deflation’ would take 3–5% off revenue in the coming year.
TCS ended the year down 23,460 net in FY2025-26, to 584,519 staff at 31 March 2026.
TCS added about 4,258 staff in Q2 FY2026-27, up to ~598,056 by 8 October 2026.
Infosys added 5,016 people across FY2025-26, ending at 328,594.
Wipro added 8,810 employees in FY2025-26, ending at 242,156.
Tech Mahindra shed 1,108 employees in FY2025-26, ending at 147,623.
TCS announced it would cut about 12,000 roles over FY2026.
Naukri's JobSpeak index recorded BPO/ITES hiring up 21% year on year in January 2026.
The goods deficit widened by $50 billion in FY2026 alone.
Software + business services share of services exports is 78.5%.
Direct tech-sector employment is about 6.0 million, ~1.1% of the workforce.
Services exports as share of GDP is ~10%.
The AI-exposed slice of services exports is about 7.7% of GDP.
